title: Accessing the data
markdown:
This dataset is licensed under the [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.en) license. You are free to share and adapt the data, provided you give appropriate credit, provide a link to the license, and indicate if changes were made.

To download the data files, you must register for a Synapse account.

${buttonlink?text=Register for a Synapse account&url=https://www%2Esynapse%2Eorg/#!RegisterAccount:0&highlight=true&align=None}

When registering, you must review and agree to the Synapse governance policies and procedures (Terms and Conditions of Use, Privacy Policy, Awareness and Ethics Pledge). You can review the Synapse Governance documents [here](https://help.synapse.org/docs/Synapse-Governance.2004255211.html).

To better assess the impact and usage of the dataset, we kindly ask you to complete a brief, two-question survey about your institution type and intended data use.

${buttonlink?text=Data access tracking&url=https://www%2Esurveymonkey%2Ecom/r/YWCKF62&highlight=true&align=None}

Version 1 of the dataset can be accessed [here](syn55052683).  This folder includes data from 185 participants (100 PD patients, 85 age-matched controls) each performing eight (8) walking and balance tasks.  More details on the data can be found in

Version 1 (Cross-sectional) of the dataset can be accessed [here](syn55052683). This folder includes data from 185 participants (100 PD patients, 85 age-matched controls) each performing 8-10walking and balance tasks. 
Version 2 (Longitudinal) of the dataset can be accessed [here](syn74686228). This folder contains longitudinal data from a subset of 47 participants with Parkinson’s disease who completed multiple data collection sessions using the same experimental protocol. Sessions are separated by a minimum of 6 months.

The Version 2 dataset follows the same structure, sensor modalities, and processing pipelines as Version 1, with the addition of repeated sessions per participant. Users should note that multiple sessions are available for a given participant and should account for within-subject correlations when performing analyses. [Note: The first session for participants included in Version 2 is also present in Version 1. Users should take care to avoid double-counting these observations when combining datasets.]  More details on the data can be found in [Data Description](https://www.synapse.org/#!Synapse:syn52540892/wiki/623753).
